page: OVHcloud r3-128 is a memory-optimized virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 dedicated physical cores of an AMD EPYC processor clocked at 2.3 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data highlights strong memory performance, with the PassMark memory score ranking in the top tier (top 10%). Large-block uncached memory read and write operations demonstrate strong performance in the top 25%, reaching 223.45 GB/sec and 117.55 GB/sec respectively. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is also strong, though multi-core CPU performance and database operations fall into the average category. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and text generation for small LLM models also perform in the top 25%.

The dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading ensures consistent execution, though the lack of hyperthreading limits concurrent thread density compared to virtualized environments with multi-threading enabled. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density combined with bundled NVMe storage makes it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads without requiring external storage attachments. This server is suited for in-memory databases, caching layers, data processing pipelines, and memory-heavy enterprise applications.
